title: The Pulse, Thursday 12 November 2026
tldr: Tim Peters, author of the Zen of Python and core contributor for decades, has died. The Node.js LTS lines all shipped security updates for nine high-severity HTTP/2, TLS, and permissions vulnerabilities. LangChain drops Python 3.10 support across core, main, and typesafe packages.

research.title: On Private Knowledge Retrieval and Private Inference for secure multi-agent systems
research.summary: Private retrieval and inference for secure multi-agent systems.
research.why: Agent systems with private knowledge retrieval are directly relevant to our multi-agent work.

research.title: Coding Agent Memory Post-Training II: Unlocking the Memory Potential of Pre-trained File Operations for Long-Horizon Tasks via On-Policy Distillation
research.summary: On-policy distillation to unlock memory control in coding agents with long-horizon tasks.
research.why: Memory management for coding agents is a live problem for Botterfly and our agent workflows.

research.title: ExpertCrowd-SWE: Measuring Frontier Coding Agents on Expert-Authored Engineering Tasks in Unfamiliar Codebases
research.summary: 100 expert-authored tasks for autonomous coding agents in large, unfamiliar codebases.
research.why: A benchmark for the exact scenario we run coding agents in: real repos, multi-file changes, expert-level tasks.

research.title: Decode Token Parallelism: Memory-Efficient Distributed Attention Parallelism for Scalable LLM Decoding
research.summary: Memory-efficient distributed attention for scalable LLM decoding with long contexts.
research.why: Relevant if we need to serve models ourselves at high concurrency and long context lengths.

releases.title: Node.js v26.13.1, v24.22.3, and v22.23.5 (all LTS)
releases.summary: All three LTS lines shipped security releases fixing nine high-severity CVEs in HTTP/2, TLS, and permissions.
releases.why: We run Node services; security updates in all LTS lines need attention.

releases.title: LangChain Core 1.8.0
releases.summary: Drops Python 3.10 support; minimum is now Python 3.11. Adds decision models.
releases.why: We use LangChain in several projects; this forces a Python upgrade if we want newer versions.

releases.title: LangChain 1.5.0
releases.summary: Also drops Python 3.10; pins Core 1.8.0. Adds model router and auto-mode middleware.
releases.why: The main package follows the core's Python cutoff; users on 3.10 stay on 1.4.x.

hackernews.title: Tim Peters has died
hackernews.summary: Tim Peters, author of the Zen of Python and core contributor for decades, has died.
hackernews.why: A foundational loss for the Python community; his work shapes every Python codebase we touch.

hackernews.title: AWS emulator
hackernews.summary: AWS released an emulator for local development: S3, DynamoDB, Lambda, and more, no cloud account needed.
hackernews.why: Faster local dev loops for AWS services; relevant for SalesKick and any AWS-based projects.

hackernews.title: Gemini Decisions API
hackernews.summary: A structured decision-making API separate from the generation models.
hackernews.why: Worth knowing; decision-focused APIs may fit routing or classifier use cases better than general chat models.

hackernews.title: Faster Retrieval for Better, More Efficient RAG
hackernews.summary: Apple research on faster retrieval for RAG: query rewriting, GPU-accelerated ANN search, and hybrid ranking.
hackernews.why: RAG performance matters for Pipeline's hybrid retrieval stacks and EverRaise's knowledge base.

x_posts.title: Hermes Agent Plugin Hackathon closed
x_posts.summary: Nous Research closed the Hermes Agent Plugin Hackathon with nearly 1,000 submissions; judges are narrowing to the top 10.
x_posts.why: We use Hermes daily; the plugin ecosystem shapes what we can build.

x_posts.title: Voxtral Transcribe 3 at AI Engineer Paris
x_posts.summary: Mistral used Voxtral Transcribe 3 for real-time transcription at AI Engineer Paris, with context biasing for names and technical terms.
x_posts.why: Real-time transcription with biasing is useful for EverRaise's voice agents; the production story is the signal.

x_posts.title: François Chollet on AI in education
x_posts.summary: Conversational AI can deliver personalized tutoring, but most tools optimize for the answer instead of learning to think.
x_posts.why: No direct use for us yet, but a useful framing if we ever build educational agents.

closing: Models: nothing new in the window. OpenRouter published four new tutorials covering agent infinite loops, benchmarking, rate limits, and quantization tradeoffs. Google announced Gemini on Apple CarPlay and AlphaGenome 2 for DNA variant impact prediction.
